title: Approval of Contract No. 8095 for Castaic Power Plant Outlet Tower Gates
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Contract No. 8095 for Castaic Power Plant Outlet Tower Gates
  with Henry Pratt Company, LLC. The Contract is for a one-time purchase
  and expenditure will not exceed $6,681,336.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15302.
summary: Contract No. 8095 for Castaic Power Plant Outlet Tower Gates with Henry Pratt Company, LLC, not to exceed $6,681,336.
